tickets.title: Coordinate education tax items with Harper Dewspindle
tickets.text: Coordinate with Harper Dewspindle of Buttonwood Balloon Tax Advisors on 529 distributions, scholarships, technology costs, and student loan interest records for Lyra Maplesprocket's Marzipan Meadow University expenses before tax-season records are assembled for Selene and Daniel Maplesprocket.
tickets.evidence: Mira noted that 529 distributions, scholarships, technology costs, and any student loan interest records should be coordinated with Harper Dewspindle before tax-season records are assembled.
